title: Safe request representation
statement: For every Boolean word $z$, there exist a CNF formula $\varphi$ over natural-number variables and a Boolean word $u$ such that the safe request on $z$ is the pairing of the serialization of $\varphi$ with $u$, every variable index occurring in $\varphi$ is less than $|u|$, and the value of $\varphi$ under the assignment given by $u$ (with variables beyond $|u|$ assigned false) equals the safe evaluation value of $z$.
replaced:
For every binary string $z$ there exist a CNF formula $\varphi$ and a word $u$ such
that the safe evaluator request on $z$ is exactly the pair encoding of the
serialization of $\varphi$ with $u$, every variable index occurring in $\varphi$ is
below $|u|$, and the truth value of $\varphi$ under the assignment read off $u$
equals the safe evaluation value of $z$. This holds also on failed splits and
failed parses.
